scope: 24 overlapping capability families cover all 82 backend units; counts are not additive product features

families.title: Home, orb, Quick Hub, Attention and notifications
families.present_specification: State reducer, severity precedence, compact hub, deep links and notification deduplication are detailed.
families.positive_journey: A genuine protection or task event creates one scoped Attention item, updates the orb, opens the right subject and records acknowledgement.
families.error_and_recovery_journey: Stale task stream with healthy market stream stays distinguishable; denied notification permission, quiet hours and dismissed previews retain critical in-app incident state; replay does not notify twice.

families.title: Installation, zero-configuration connection and navigation
families.present_specification: Signed provisioning and no raw host/token forms are explicit; identity/app-signing continuity is required.
families.positive_journey: Fresh signed install receives/verifies provisioning, enrolls owner/device, connects to the admitted gateway, reads service capabilities and restores an authorized deep link without typing backend configuration.
families.error_and_recovery_journey: Expired provisioning, rotated service certificate/endpoint, lost/replaced/revoked handset, clock skew, unavailable backend and app restore have distinct repair paths; an old device cannot regain authority.

families.title: Markets, portfolio summaries, watchlists, screening and alerts
families.present_specification: Instrument identity, freshness, watchlists and server-side alerts are included.
families.positive_journey: Find an instrument, persist a watchlist/screen rule, receive a server-evaluated alert and open the exact venue/instrument with source time.
families.error_and_recovery_journey: Feed gap, delisting, alias collision, market closure, entitlement denial, process death and duplicate alert delivery preserve accurate data and one alert identity.

families.title: Charts, indicators, drawings, replay, depth and workspaces
families.evidence_location: Part B §7 and chart bridge contracts
families.present_specification: Professional chart scope and untrusted bridge boundaries are substantial; replay isolation is explicit.
families.positive_journey: Save drawings and indicator settings, restore a multi-chart workspace, inspect real order overlays, run isolated replay and submit a typed observation to research.
families.error_and_recovery_journey: Unsupported depth/order types are explicit; reconnect gaps, WebView/native renderer failure, malformed bridge inputs and workspace conflicts preserve instrument precision and never execute from a chart.

families.title: Manual orders, positions, protection, risk, handover, history and TCA
families.present_specification: Financial invariants, unknown outcomes, child reservations and ownership transitions are deeply specified.
families.positive_journey: Preview a scoped order, confirm within mandate, receive partial/final fills with protection, hand control between owner and VAN, then reconcile cash and TCA.
families.error_and_recovery_journey: Concurrent spend, partial fill, cancel race, exchange outage, unknown submission, late correction and restart preserve exposure, protection, unique intents and readback.

families.title: Accounts, authentication, KYC, funds, payments and statements
families.present_specification: Local unlink/remote closure, settled funding and provider-hosted flows are explicitly separated.
families.positive_journey: Link or create an admitted account, validate access, rotate credentials, deposit/withdraw/transfer through the supported flow and reconcile settlement/statement.
families.error_and_recovery_journey: Observe-only access, KYC restriction, expired hosted callback, duplicate transfer, disputed/returned payment and open exposure prevent false success or unsafe closure.

families.title: Strategies, trading modes and policy promotion
families.evidence_location: Part A §§2, 6, 9; Part B trading mode contracts
families.present_specification: Operational adaptation and separately authorized policy evolution are well distinguished.
families.positive_journey: Inspect strategy evidence, select an admitted mode, authorize an exact policy change and verify active consumer/version and current risk bounds.
families.error_and_recovery_journey: Inconclusive edge, revoked mandate, changed candidate, active old-version parent, drift and rollback preserve existing protections and qualified fallback.

families.title: Forecasting, models, self-improvement and economic experiments
families.evidence_location: Part A §§8–10; forecast contracts and research experiment register
families.present_specification: Targets, temporal validation, calibration, chance controls, Jev/model budgets, independent evaluation and positive feedback proof are detailed.
families.positive_journey: Seal a full opportunity cohort, diagnose outcomes with uncertainty, evaluate a candidate after full costs, qualify it, observe a changed later decision and reproduce that decision from retained evidence.
families.error_and_recovery_journey: Contamination, future-data leakage, sparse cohorts, model alias change, interrupted budget settlement, corrected labels and drift yield explicit ineligible/inconclusive states and qualified fallback.

families.title: News, calendar, analyst, event impact and armed tickets
families.present_specification: Citations, source contradictions, event timing and bounded D1–D7 influence are explicit.
families.positive_journey: Read a sourced event analysis, inspect affected holdings, obtain a grounded analyst answer, and arm an eligible exact news ticket whose actual outcome is reconciled.
families.error_and_recovery_journey: Duplicate/revised stories, bad timestamps, unavailable source, contradictory facts, late release and expired single-use ticket cannot create fabricated certainty or repeated trading.

families.title: Prediction-market information, probability and research laboratories
families.evidence_location: Part B forecast/prediction integration; forecast contract files
families.present_specification: Event identity, calibration, non-atomic arbitrage and market-making laboratories are retained as research scope.
families.positive_journey: Capture a time-qualified event distribution and evaluate its incremental asset/research value, preserving settlement and fee assumptions in the report.
families.error_and_recovery_journey: Void/disputed resolution, source disagreement, absent liquidity, stale quotes and non-atomic fills fail the appropriate research claim; no lab creates live order authority.

families.title: Centralized-exchange spot crypto execution
families.present_specification: Actual spot execution is distinct from read-only chain research and derivatives.
families.positive_journey: Use the admitted venue/account/instrument, satisfy size/precision filters, trade spot and reconcile asset inventory, protection and fees in their true currencies.
families.error_and_recovery_journey: Book gap, rate limit, nonce/clock issue, stop support mismatch, fee asset shortage and dead-man cancellation preserve truthful exposure and recovery priority.

families.title: Chain discovery, security, wallets and executable-economics research
families.evidence_location: Part B §30; high_value schemas and contracts
families.present_specification: Full cohorts, chain-specific identity, sellability uncertainty, finality and read-only boundaries are detailed.
families.positive_journey: Inspect a discovered asset, state-bound security analysis, independent buy/sell quotes, wallet attribution and matched-cohort economics with citations.
families.error_and_recovery_journey: Reorganization, unsupported extension/proxy, unavailable sell path, incomplete holdings and censored exit remain explicit unknowns and invalidate dependent evidence.

families.title: Projects, tasks, missions, graphs, progress and approvals
families.present_specification: Stable node/edge IDs, meaningful progress, accessible list and lease-aware actions are well described.
families.positive_journey: Create or update a permitted task, inspect its dependency graph, resolve a blocker, review evidence and observe authoritative verified completion.
families.error_and_recovery_journey: Cycle, stale revision, concurrent edit, failed review, missing handoff and lost cancellation response never fabricate progress or dispatch twice; reconcile original task/job.

families.title: Agents, Hermes, Muse, Jev and provider-bound interventions
families.evidence_location: Part B §9.6; BE-024; shared Jev clauses
families.present_specification: Native ownership, provider approvals and independent work/task/artifact outcomes are explicit.
families.positive_journey: Observe a real assignment, steer the exact permitted job, answer its bound approval and inspect its native outcome/artifact.
families.error_and_recovery_journey: Expired lease, late callback, worker replacement, provider outage and revoked capability retain native identities and enforce current scopes.

families.title: Development studio, design/research workspaces, CI and security
families.evidence_location: BE-034; Part B §11.5 and studio contexts
families.present_specification: Evidence/workspace adapters and source-candidate admission are preserved, but largely specified at capability level.
families.positive_journey: Open a real source/workspace artifact, inspect CI/security/design evidence, request an authorized native action and verify its exact build/source outcome.
families.error_and_recovery_journey: Wrong branch/artifact, stale review, unavailable plugin and failed build remain distinct; a workspace control cannot imply deployment or mint authority.

families.title: Conversation, speech input/output and speaker consent
families.present_specification: Turns, transcript/audio streaming, interruption, history and consent exist as obligations; detailed turn/audio protocol remains to be materialized.
families.positive_journey: Speak a scoped request, inspect corrected interpretation, receive an intelligible spoken answer, follow up, interrupt playback and obtain a verified spoken effect result when applicable.
families.error_and_recovery_journey: Ambiguous account/amount, ASR correction, TTS failure, Bluetooth/audio-focus change, phone call, interruption, timeout, reconnection and revoked mic consent preserve one turn/command and a usable text path.

families.title: Floating assistant, workboards, gestures and Android lifecycle
families.present_specification: Tap/double-tap/long-press, drag/dock/minimize/restore, workboard and lifecycle preservation are explicit.
families.positive_journey: Open and move the assistant without obstructing another app, switch to conversation/work/trades and restore the correct state after process recreation.
families.error_and_recovery_journey: Overlay denial, locked screen, service restart restriction, keyboard collision, occlusion, battery saver and dismissed state use documented OS-compatible recovery without hidden mic capture.

families.title: Memory, knowledge, research, privacy, goals and adaptations
families.present_specification: Fact provenance, corrections, retraction, erasure exceptions and adaptation review are represented.
families.positive_journey: Retrieve a cited fact, correct it, change a goal, review or roll back an adaptation and erase the specified retained scope with verified readback.
families.error_and_recovery_journey: Conflicting facts, stale index, cross-project query, revoked source, derived cache and retained backup cannot silently revive erased material or equate deletion with model unlearning.

families.title: Automation, reminders, schedules and standing consent
families.present_specification: Candidate/admitted versions, DST/misfire and unknown-effect reconciliation are required.
families.positive_journey: Admit a scoped workflow, set a schedule/reminder, observe next/last run, pause or revoke it and inspect per-step durable outcomes.
families.error_and_recovery_journey: DST transition, clock jump, overlapping run, missed schedule, consent expiry and timeout after effect use explicit policies and reconcile before retry.

families.title: Browser, remote devices, files, artifacts and share intake
families.present_specification: Session leases, observed targets, file destinations and untrusted source content are explicit.
families.positive_journey: Open an admitted session, observe the target, execute an exact permitted interaction, import/export an allowed artifact and verify destination/outcome.
families.error_and_recovery_journey: Navigation changes target, stale viewport, interrupted upload, malicious content, oversized file, revoked lease and unknown click outcome require bounded recovery and original-operation lookup.

families.title: ARTEMIS tests, devices, captures and evidence
families.present_specification: Real device/build identity and pass/fail/unknown are clearly required.
families.positive_journey: Choose an admitted device and exact APK, run/cancel a plan, inspect captures and independently resolve the test attempt outcome.
families.error_and_recovery_journey: Device disconnect, missing capture, wrong APK, attempt restart and stale result remain unknown/failed rather than physical-device acceptance.

families.title: Connected services, permissions, devices, diagnostics and preferences
families.present_specification: Provider health versus authority, signed provisioning, notification/voice preferences and redaction are specified.
families.positive_journey: Inspect per-service readiness/scopes, change permitted preferences, revoke a device/consent and export scoped redacted diagnostics.
families.error_and_recovery_journey: Healthy transport with unavailable action, pending Android permission, stale setting revision and expired enrollment remain distinct; recovery preserves privacy choices.

families.title: Whole-app navigation, accessibility, themes and device performance
families.present_specification: Both themes, 234 contexts, reduced motion, scale, process death and S24 checks are explicit.
families.positive_journey: Navigate every accepted context/action in both themes with large text/TalkBack, recover back-stack and pending references after process death, and keep critical controls readable.
families.error_and_recovery_journey: Malformed/expired deep link, low memory, no network, slow render, theme switch and visual effect degradation preserve state and access to required controls.

families.title: Security, data durability, deployment, migration, release and recovery
families.present_specification: Exact source admission, signed intents, outbox/reconciliation, recovery and global backend gate are mandatory.
families.positive_journey: Deploy a pinned release, migrate and restore state, connect the signed app, observe domain health, rotate credentials and verify a compatible rollback.
families.error_and_recovery_journey: Crash after dispatch, backup/ledger inconsistency, revoked signing authority, schema incompatibility, resource exhaustion and restore of old consent must preserve financial truth and current revocations.
